name: brain-extraction-13-11-26
summary: Skull-strips a T1-weighted image with FSL BET (optional robust centre estimation and bias/neck cleanup); appears to be an incomplete test copy of the Brain Extraction (FSL BET) App.
description: Contains run_bet.sh and brain_extract.py but no main script, so it cannot run on brainlife as registered; run_bet.sh also writes to t1_brain/ rather than the registered t1w_brain output. Use the Brain Extraction (FSL BET) App instead.

outputs.description: Brain-extracted T1w image produced by FSL BET.

parameters.description: Fractional intensity threshold (0–1). Smaller values give larger brain outlines.
Run robust brain centre estimation, iterating BET several times.
Run bias field correction and neck cleanup (-B flag).
